subject: GCP field engagement: marketplace readiness checklist & customer prioritization
messages:
From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acme.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Anika Shah <anika.shah@google.com>
Cc: Lin Goh <lin.goh@marketplace.io>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing + next steps for Acme POC

Hi Neha / Anika,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme is keen to move the POC forward and the procurement team asked about two things before we can lock timelines:

- Whether Redwood can be listed on GCP Marketplace with a usage-based (metered) SKU;
- Typical go-live lead time once listing is approved (they want an internal timeline to align procurement + security audit).

I've attached the vendor RFP (short version) that lists procurement questions. Can someone from Redwood confirm who owns the GCP Marketplace listing work and whether Redwood has a standard marketplace readiness checklist we can share?

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Best,
Tom Riley
Dir, Cloud Platform Strategy
Acme Corp

[Attachment: acme-rfp.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acme.com>
Cc: Anika Shah <anika.shah@google.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + next steps for Acme POC

Tom — thanks for sharing the RFP. Looping in Camila (Partnerships) and Marcus (Marketplace ops) to triage.

High-level answers up front:
- Yes, we support metered SKUs on GCP Marketplace; implementation varies by billing integration and whether the customer opts for private pricing.
- Typical time-to-live for a new listing (from accepted submission to public listing) is 4–6 weeks, but for partner-managed co-sell deals we often compress that to 2–3 weeks if GCP is sponsoring the listing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal readiness review (Camila + Marcus) against our marketplace checklist (attached).
2) Joint call with Tom, Anika, and Acme procurement to confirm required artifacts (SOC2 evidence, integration token, billing flow).
3) Draft mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and sign-offs — target to get MAP in 48 hours.

I've attached our quick checklist; Camila / Marcus please flag gaps and owners.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

[Attachment: marketplace-readiness-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + next steps for Acme POC

Thanks Neha — did a quick pass on the RFP and checklist. A few tactical notes for Acme / GCP:

Required artifacts (we can provide):
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (current) — we can share the audit report + bridge letter.
- Integration docs (API keys, usage reporting endpoint) — Marcus will drop a stub.
- Branding assets and short product blurb for the listing.

Open questions for Acme / GCP:
- Will Acme require private pricing or commit/usage-tiered pricing? That affects SKU creation and billing flow.
- Any specific security controls beyond SOC2 (e.g., VPC Peering, allowed IP ranges)?

Proposed owners and target dates:
- Marcus: billing integration spec + sample usage report — EOD Wed (Aug 4).
- Laura: legal onboarding touchpoint for marketplace terms (and DocuSign readiness) — EOD Thu (Aug 5).
- Neha / Camila: schedule joint call with GCP / Acme — target Tue Aug 3, 9–10am PT.

Tom — can you confirm if Acme prefers a public listing or private listing first? If they want private listing behind their org, that adds ~1 week to the process.

Camila Reyes
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Adding the ops view. Quick notes:

- Billing: for metered SKUs we expose a usage reporting endpoint. Acme will need to confirm whether they want Redwood-billed or GCP-billed. If GCP-billed, we'll need to align on the reporting schema and an account mapping (customer billing id).
- Implementation timeline: assuming we have the checklist items (SOC2, branding, API docs), submission + GCP verification normally completes in ~3 weeks. If GCP is running a co-sell motion (Anika confirmed interest), we can request priority review which historically cuts the verification step to ~1 week.

DocuSign: Laura, can you prepare a marketplace-specific addendum so we can attach it to the MAP? I'll link the DocuSign in the MAP when it's ready.

Linking a stub of the usage schema here for reference:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/usage-schema-stub

Marcus Lin

1) Joint readiness call scheduled: Tue Aug 3, 2026 — 9:00–9:30am PT (calendar invite sent). Attendees: Acme procurement (Tom), GCP PM (Anika), Redwood: Neha/ Camila/ Marcus/Laura.
2) Marcus: provide usage reporting schema + sample by EOD Wed Aug 4 (attachment link above).
3) Laura: draft marketplace addendum + DocuSign flow by Thu Aug 5.
4) Tom/Acme: confirm public vs private listing preference on the call.

- Any required security controls beyond SOC2 (short bullets).
